EnableNpcGenerator.Name: Enable NPC Generator
EnableNpcGenerator.Hint: Adds a tab to NPC sheets that randomly rolls a name, instinct, and trait.

EnableMonsterGenerator.Name: Enable Monster Stat Generator
EnableMonsterGenerator.Hint: Adds a tab to NPC sheets that randomly rolls a damage die, armor, HP, and coin.

EnableAttackAssistant.Name: Enable Attack Damage Automation
EnableAttackAssistant.Hint: On a success or partial success for a melee (Hack & Slash) or ranged (Volley) move, asks whether to roll damage and automatically deducts consumables like ammo.

MeleeMoveNames.Name: Melee Move Names
MeleeMoveNames.Hint: Move names (comma separated) that should trigger the damage prompt as a melee attack. Adjust this if a translation module renamed the move.

RangedMoveNames.Name: Ranged Move Names
RangedMoveNames.Hint: Move names (comma separated) that should trigger the damage prompt as a ranged attack. These also trigger the ammo consumption prompt.

Npc.RollButtonTitle: Randomly re-roll this NPC's name, instinct, and trait. Can be repeated any number of times.

Monster.RollButtonTitle: Randomly re-roll this NPC's damage die, armor, HP, and coin.

Attack.WeaponLabel: Which weapon did you attack with?
Attack.NoWeapons: {name} has no weapon equipment; skipping the damage roll.
Attack.NoTargets: No targeted tokens to apply damage to.
